reclassification.title: Change the legal entity type?
reclassification.description: What we ask about the company's partners and related parties depends on it.
reclassification.routeChange: Changing to “{type}” changes the registration route, so the related-parties sections you filled no longer apply. {removed} will be removed, and the sections of the new route start empty.
reclassification.rolesTaken: Changing to “{type}” changes the required roles. Nobody is removed, but roles are taken away: {losing}.
reclassification.rolesRemoved: Changing to “{type}” changes the required roles. {removed} will be removed, having no current role left. Everyone else is kept.
reclassification.alsoLosing: Roles are also taken away from {losing}.
reclassification.brokenLinks: It also leaves {links} without their person: you will need to designate someone again before submitting the request.
